display.purpose: Page titles and phase names only.

title.purpose: Section titles and drawer topic title.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: 2px hover settle on rows and cards.

motion.name: current-pulse
motion.purpose: The single looping motion: the current topic marker.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single affirmative action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #e8e6dd); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--ink, #e8e6dd); color: var(--surface-0, #141813); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink, #e8e6dd) 88%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phase-1, #7ac48a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; hairline outline, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgba(232,230,221,0.26)); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #e8e6dd); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #2c312b); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink, #e8e6dd) 40%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phase-1, #7ac48a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: 20px square subtopic checkbox with hand-drawn check.
components.html: <button class="ds-check" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Mark subtopic complete"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8.5 6.4 11.8 13 4.6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-check { display: inline-grid; place-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--phase-1, #7ac48a); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--phase-1, #7ac48a); color: var(--phase-contrast, #141813); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-check:not([aria-pressed="true"]) { background: transparent; color: transparent; border-color: var(--hairline-strong, rgba(232,230,221,0.26)); } .ds-check:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink, #e8e6dd) 45%, transparent); } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--phase-1, #7ac48a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field for start date and notes.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgba(232,230,221,0.26)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-1, #1c201b); color: var(--ink, #e8e6dd); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-subtle, #9b9d94); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--phase-1, #7ac48a) 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--phase-1, #7ac48a); }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Grouped content block for dashboard sections and notes.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(232,230,221,0.14)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-1, #1c201b); color: var(--ink, #e8e6dd); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-subtle, #9b9d94); } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 28px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: Sticky 64px ruled bar with mono view index.
components.html: BACKEND ROADMAPRoadmapField logTimeline
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 64px; padding: 0 40px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(232,230,221,0.14)); background: var(--surface-0, #141813); color: var(--ink, #e8e6dd); } .ds-nav-brand { margin-right: auto; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #b0b2a9); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-active { border-bottom-color: var(--phase-1, #7ac48a); color: var(--ink, #e8e6dd); }

narrative.overview: The app should feel like a working document pinned to a drafting table: graphite surfaces, measured hairlines, compact annotations, and one flat signal colour per phase. It is a tool that records work, not a dashboard that performs enthusiasm. Dark is the default working light; light mode is drafting paper, not a different product. The roadmap itself is the composition. Structure comes from 1px rules, a tight type scale, and generous margins before it comes from boxes.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite canvas with a green undertone; cool paper in light mode.
Hairline structure; one border, one accent.
Flat phase tints, never gradients, glows, or tinted glass.
Mono data type with tabular numerals; display face reserved for names and titles.
Measured 2–6px radii; controls on a 4px baseline.

rules.name: The One Border, One Accent Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from hairlines, type scale, and whitespace before boxes. Phase tints occupy less than 10% of any viewport.

rules.name: The Flat Signal Rule
rules.body: Phase colours are flat tints. Never gradients, glows, or tinted glass.

rules.name: The Mono Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every percentage, duration, date, week count, and keyboard hint uses JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only for overlays and as a response to state.

dos: Do keep phase tints under 10% of any viewport and use them only for real state.
Do set every number, date, and duration in mono with tabular numerals.
Do use 1px hairlines and tonal steps before adding a border or a shadow.
Do align controls to the 4px baseline and use 40px desktop / 44px mobile heights.
Do preserve visible focus rings and 44px touch targets at 375px.
Do let the roadmap content carry the composition; chrome stays quiet.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, glassmorphism, blobs, or emoji icons.
Don't use pill-shaped navigation, badges, or buttons.
Don't set numbers in the display face or body copy in mono.
Don't add looping motion beyond the current-topic pulse.
Don't invent encouragement, social proof, or marketing headings.
Don't replace the field-notebook world with a generic dashboard look.
